mainEntity.name: What is the difference between AI search optimization and PPC (Pay-Per-Click) for law firms?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI search optimization and PPC are distinct digital marketing strategies. AI search optimization focuses on improving a law firm's organic (unpaid) search rankings over time through content optimization, technical SEO, and building authority, often with AI-driven insights. PPC, conversely, involves paying search engines to display ads prominently for specific keywords. While PPC offers immediate visibility, AI search optimization builds sustainable, long-term organic traffic and brand authority without direct advertising costs per click. Both can be complementary, but their mechanisms and timelines for results differ significantly.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI search optimization improves unpaid organic rankings long-term, while PPC provides immediate, paid ad visibility; both can be complementary but operate differently.
